answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 164320 Country: India Title: Name for my Baby boy Question: Allah has given me a baby boy on 07-07-2018. I need a best name for my baby. Please suggest a best name for my baby. Baby Father Name - Tayseer ul Haq. Baby Mother Name - Subia Farheen. We selected Mohammed Zayyan. Is this good Name. Please give meaning. Please suggest good name with meaning for my baby. Answer ID: 164320 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1304/1113/N=01/1440) (1) Zayyan means the one who decorates too much, Embellisher, thus you may keep the name Zayyan. (2) There are some other names , you may keep any of them if you like: Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Abdur Rahim, Abdul Haq, Alimul Haq, Fahimul Haq, Saeedul Haq, Muhammad Abdullah, Muhammad Abdur Rahman, Muhammad Ahmad, Muhammad Ibrahim, Muhammad Yahya, Muhammad Abu Bakar, Muhammad Umar, Muhammad Usman, Muhammad Anas, Muhammad Furqan, Muhammad Affan, Muhammad Fauzan, Muhammad Saleh, Muhammad Muzammil, Muhammad Sulaiman, Muhammad Salman, Muhammad Sauban, Muhammad Talha, Abu Ubaidah, Muhammad Tahir, Muhammad Huzaifah, Muhammad Khalid, Muhammad Muavia, Muhammad Shuaib, Muhammad Sadiq, Muhammad Ibrahim and Muhammad Saleh etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
